shadowDecision.rationale: Select only the exact currently familiar bounded task; no physiological calibration, novel dose, full-week sufficiency or efficacy is inferred

target.cue: Comfortable conversational running, slow or walk to retain comfortable speech; stop and reassess if symptoms or technique/function changes

scientificConditions.rationale: A familiar task-specific target can be rebound only to an exact already tolerated finite recipe under comparable conditions. This is calibration/selection of a known task, never physiological equivalence or permission for an unexposed hard family.
preserve: Current adequate chosen plan and completed history.
Explicit athlete priority, current eligibility, essential intent and other adequate sessions.
modify: Only the prospective finite action allowed by the exact reviewed request.
scientificConditions.mec_change_level: Existing action class and prospective horizon in registry; no new MEC numerical scale.
scientificConditions.trade_off: Protocol choice has population and task-specific uncertainty; no guaranteed adaptation, recovery or injury prevention Lower volume may forgo adaptation; rescheduling may disturb commitments; no exact outcome is promised.
must_not: Infer normality, competence, calibration or tolerance from missing data.
Apply effects, mutate official plans, prescribe clinically or publish Product Truth.
Use abstract principles as proof of exact individual efficacy or safety.
conditions: Require exact selected recipe toleranceFactId/toleratedRecipeId and compatible current exposure, complete associated facts, target method and construct; a bare tolerance boolean is insufficient.
Easy/long practical talk cues do not identify LT2/CS. Familiar cruise/VO2-style/strides targets remain task anchors; pace, HR, power and laboratory constructs are not interchangeable.
Keep already concrete adequate prescriptions; missing hard-family calibration routes ASK/NOT_SUPPORTED_YET, and any easy fallback itself requires exact familiar tolerance.

limitations: Provisional AI review; no human credentials, human validation, empirical product validation or clinical clearance.
Synthetic conformance and supplied current facts do not establish real-person safety, causality, adherence or optimality.
Exact numeric choices remain bounded protocol choices under explicit conditions; relevant contradictions invalidate them.

nextCheck.trigger: Response, symptoms, task, source, context or authority changes; before any further prescription
nextCheck.exit: Reassess exact current facts; no automatic progression

materialContract.scope: Typed source-bound request operands, explicit unknowns and eligibility/gap routing; not arbitrary narrative comprehension, sporting sufficiency, dose-readiness or population coverage

scientificConditions.trade_off: Answers the requested finite steady task while declining new calibration, progression and whole-week sufficiency.
must_not: Infer LT2/CS/MLSS or any VO2 target
Use familiar history after interruption, adverse response, stale/duplicate evidence or conflicting current context
Add dose, faster pace, a schedule commitment or automatic next prescription
Mutate official/completed/applied state or claim human/empirical validation
conditions: Require exact candidate bytes and all same-family/calibration/environment hashes, current explicit nonclinical eligibility and adult recreational intermediate-running scope.

Current input must fail closed on clinical observations, conflicting age/population, adapter.blocked, interruption, stale/duplicate evidence, incompatible response or other material contradictory metadata; mere historical hash matches are insufficient.

Selection answers only the one requested familiar steady exposure; preserve effort cue and all10/15/5min components without physiological equivalence, effect/safety probability, progression or week-adequacy claim.
If material facts are missing, ASK; if clinical concern exists, CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED. Bind this exact review and the single funded-human queue before positive coverage.
Observe actual completion, effort, technique, symptoms and response before any later prescription; current symptoms/function changes stop dependent judgment.

limitations: Source evidence supports construct discipline and practical interpretation, not this exact individual dose efficacy.
Synthetic reported compatibility/current comparability are premises; the adapter must not infer them from experience labels.
Approval of candidate is distinct from final current runtime binding review.
